title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Targeted response to essential needs of affected communities in Kachin State and Southeast Myanmar programme is implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include conduct protection risk assessments and technical support to partners to establish mechanisms for receiving, managing and responding to sensitive and non-sensitive complaints and feedback so, communities and people affected by crisis can hold Trócaire and local partners accountable against our commitments for an inclusive, dignified, and safe response. Programmes are in partnership with Serve the World, KDG and EcoDev (ALARM). ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Establish new systems & structures through which groups, communities or people can lead the response through an active and influential role in shaping decisions that affect their lives- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys
